title: Ask who is speaking when ego sounds ordinary
summary: The shabad calls ego a chronic illness, but does not leave the soul helpless. Its cure begins when the self-important voice is exposed before the Guru's Shabad.
takeaway: Name the ego-voice before it borrows your mouth.
lifeApplication: When self-importance rises in the throat or chest, pause before the sentence forms. Ask whether the words would serve the Shabad's cure or simply protect the swollen self.

source.shortMeaning: Ego is a chronic illness, yet the cure appears when its voice is exposed before the Guru's Shabad.
